messages.content:
Heads up: your local repo's `origin` remote points to `https://github.com/Qolok/Meridian.git`, not `https://github.com/Emberstone-Studio/Meridian.git`. Your local `main` is 34 commits behind that `origin`.

A couple of options:
1. **You meant to pull from origin as-is** (Qolok/Meridian) — I can just run `git pull` and fast-forward the 34 commits.
2. **Emberstone-Studio/Meridian is a different/renamed remote** (e.g. org migrated) — I'd add/repoint the remote and pull from there instead.

Which do you want?

Good — this confirms it's the right history: local `HEAD` is just the initial commit (`83eb126`), and Emberstone-Studio's `origin/main` has 35 commits building on top of it, with your local `HEAD` as an ancestor. This is a clean fast-forward, no divergence.

Proceeding to pull.

Done. Repo now pulled from `Emberstone-Studio/Meridian.git`:

- Repointed `origin` to `https://github.com/Emberstone-Studio/Meridian.git`
- Fast-forwarded `main` from `83eb126` → `76eaa90` (34 new commits, 34 files added — the full extension source: `background.js`, `meridian.js`, `components/`, `utils/`, `img/`, `manifest.json`, etc.)
- Working tree is clean and up to date with origin/main

Note: `.tasker/` and `meridian-extension/` remain as untracked local files (unrelated to this repo's tracked content) — left them alone since you didn't ask me to touch them.
